title: Coefficient4 logarithmic-divisor family tuning dimension for the look-ahead source

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Select lexmin(k,j,B,E0),first feasible E0 per(a,B);no field bound until selected. Take explicit Y-bit initial prefix. All selection uses N,S only. B5 uses supplied A2sampler,A1D4helper,weakhash,exactboundedfreshseedrounds;prefixdegree1000w/output250w. CompleteG nonlinear. Layoutdelta1/125,m=floor(r/125),b=floor(Tw/(30*125\u00b2)),u=2b+2w+10,w=ceil_logr;scaleT\u00b2. One fixed goodS0 is paid. Allheaders/data handled by one polynomial algorithm;NP emptywitness. Exact margin gives badgroup product<=2^(-sqrtL+O_S0(z));prefixP=O_S0(L\u00b2z\u00b2)=o(k),includingALLheader/data bits.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^5/log2(log2(log2 N)). For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^(5+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(9+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed gamma header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=O_S0(L^2*(ceil(log2 L))^2)=o(k), including the shared growing-dimension package serving all four maps. The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2) ROW independence and O(r^2*u) log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed. C29 uses Cw=31500,Cy=86000 and internalD=max(2,ceil(10z/7)) with component-specific full-request entropy,ell=P2(8ze),and one full dyadicP2(M) internal call with explicitM-bit prefix. Supplied shared-field W/T advice(978120143/62500)Reqez\u00b2<Kw/2=15750Reqez\u00b2 andE2/E3 advice(132891448/3125)Reqez\u00b2<Ky/2=43000Reqez\u00b2 and totalseed<7ze pay exact source/seed/rank obligations. Joint initialD10 search retains its exact error-margin guard. At ONE fixed good packed code,the limsup of complete certified-loss ratio to the preceding split Cw=36500/Cy=73000/D=ceil(29z/16)/ell8 allocation is at most63/73. Fields,prefixes,layouts/functions may change. Full divisor theorem and native4,1 remain.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
